reviewer: diction_bfm_medium; data author, independent of native implementations; not independent native-human linguistic gold

method.structural: Inspect every actual emitted span for exact UTF-16 source geometry, reviewed target face/Latin reading, unchanged surrounding source, and agreement with Android mixed output; compare actual direct outputs between platforms.
method.linguistic: Read complete reconstructed Apple outputs for every source-target direction using charger/address examples, all 87 distinct standalone originals with rotating targets, all 33 formula originals, high-risk Chinese/Japanese outputs and controls. Compare Android full-sentence differences and manually inspect material differences. This is finite authored-case review, not a population accuracy estimate.
method.android_linguistic: All 5512 direct complete outputs compared against the Apple-reviewed outputs; 72 differing complete sentences inspected as Chinese native-token abstentions. Additional Korean/Swahili complete formula and all eight standalone sentences inspected with Arabic target readings, including unchanged source grammar. Every emitted tuple across all targets checked against finite-reviewed grid.

r01_material_failure: Both platforms substituted bread inside 吃面包虫. Native token edges alone did not establish the authored sense.
r02_corrections: Whole-sentence formula scope with exact punctuation
Japanese railway source narrowed from 駅は to 電車の駅; bare standalone 駅 withheld
Eight self-disambiguating compound groups across 87 authored source forms
known_limits: Apple Chinese water alternatives abstain on complete native word edges; Android admits those water examples but abstains for several other Chinese contexts.

Android mixed breadworm/coffee example rejects breadworm correctly but also abstains on coffee because ICU groups 想喝 and context starts inside that native word. This does not prove independent positive-output survival in that particular Android example.
Swahili charger phrase may exceed native per-sentence token budget at direct density 0.5.

Mixed source articles and inflections remain unchanged even when the target noun has different gender or number conventions. This is the intended source-grammar contract, not a claim that the full mixed sentence follows target grammar.
Shipped en-ja/en-sw providers take priority in composed routes; their reviewed shorter spans or exact-sentence references are not new candidate full-compound success.
At default density 0.25, many multiword Korean/Swahili focuses abstain despite direct 0.5 success. All110 fixture directions having some output does not imply useful coverage of arbitrary messages.
benign_variation: Greeting register and regional vocabulary vary within stated everyday senses.
Latin readings are authored pronunciation aids, not IPA; historical provider romanization styles can differ.
production_acceptance: No material meaning correction required for this finite package. Suitable for root review and disabled portable packaging; activation remains root-owned. This is neither conversation-wide coverage nor native-human gold.

android.capture_reconciliation: 4510 durable original cases plus 1002 disjoint Korean/Swahili continuation cases; harness serialization OOM retained, no runtime/data change or repeated broad suite.

structural_result.difference_scope: All Chinese source; emitted source/target/readings agree whenever both emit. Differences are native word-boundary or recognition abstentions, including Android water successes and Apple-only coffee in mixed control.
structural_result.composed_non_grid_outputs: Only preserved en-ja/en-sw providers; explicitly reviewed rather than attributed to candidate.
